title: Ensembles of Random Partition-Based Models under Covariate Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.05195v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distribution shifts, including covariate shifts, are ubiquitous in real-world applications of machine learning. Empirical evidence suggests that, across a variety of models with and without downstream adaptation, ensembles tend to be more robust to covariate shift than single models. We extend the theory of covariate shift severity from single models to ensembles, providing theoretical justification for the empirical trends. We introduce new discrepancy measures of covariate shift severity to control the risk of partition-based kernel estimators. We then show that with sufficient ensemble size, these models can achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under covariate shift. Our results suggest that modelers can expect to need larger ensemble sizes for more severe covariate shifts.

translated_title: 协变量偏移下基于随机划分模型的集成方法
translated_abstract: 分布偏移（包括协变量偏移）在机器学习的实际应用中无处不在。经验证据表明，无论模型是否经过下游适应，集成模型在各种模型类型中往往比单一模型对协变量偏移更加稳健。我们将协变量偏移严重程度的理论从单一模型扩展到集成模型，为这些经验现象提供了理论依据。我们引入了新的协变量偏移严重程度差异度量方法，用于控制基于划分的核估计器的风险。随后我们证明，在足够大的集成规模下，这些模型能够在协变量偏移条件下达到极小极大最优的风险收敛速率。我们的结果表明，面对更严重的协变量偏移，建模者需要使用更大的集成规模。
tldr: 本文将协变量偏移严重程度理论从单一模型扩展到集成模型，证明了基于随机划分的集成模型在足够大的集成规模下可在协变量偏移下达到极小极大最优风险收敛速率，且偏移越严重所需的集成规模越大。
en_tdlr: This paper extends covariate shift severity theory from single models to ensembles, proving that random partition-based ensembles can achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under covariate shift with sufficient ensemble size, and that more severe shifts require larger ensembles.
